input_reference_role: Static reconstruction of saved nine-layer Unity menu artwork at reference resolution, no UI buttons; WebP upload proxy is lossy.
notes: The reference is a static approximation from saved serialized scene data; it is not a verified render of the latest saved scene. The input sent to FAL was a full-resolution WebP quality-75 proxy. Original underlying art includes pixel-style detail; increasing pixel dimensions does not eliminate that style.
